stemMd: Of 100 parcels, 40 are express and 60 standard. Six express and four standard parcels arrive late. Given that a parcel is late, what is the probability it is express?
explanationMd: Condition on the ten late parcels, six of which are express. The required probability is 6/10=3/5. The denominator is the conditioned group.

distractorRationale.b: Uses all express parcels as the denominator.
